rationale: PCT01 flagged the extracted pct_of_net_assets sum of 254.1 as outside the expected range, but the raw Schedule of Investments itself reports Total investments at fair value 1,355,641 and 254.1% of net assets. The stored aggregate matches the filing total; the issue is the rule expectation that total investments must be near 100% for this levered BDC-style schedule.
